<style>
:root{

article

*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box}

/* Codes, DP IDs, phone numbers and table figures line up in columns,

ul{margin:0;padding-left:1.15em}

:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #005fcc;outline-offset:2px}

.shell{max-width:var(--shell);margin:0 auto;padding-left:var(--gutter);padding-right:var(--gutter)}
.section{padding:72px 0}
.section--tight{padding:40px 0}
.dark{background:var(--primary);color:var(--paper)}

.eyebrow{

}
/* Lucida Grande is a wide face — at display sizes it needs the tracking

.h-xl{font-size:clamp(38px,5.2vw,66px);color:var(--primary);letter-spacing:-.015em}
.h-lg{font-size:clamp(34px,4.6vw,60px);color:var(--primary);letter-spacing:-.015em}
.h-md{font-size:clamp(22px,2.4vw,28px)}
.h-sm{font-size:18px;font-style:italic}
.it{font-style:italic}
.gold{color:var(--gold)}
.on-dark{color:var(--paper)}

/* ============================================================
   HEADER
   ============================================================ */
.site-header{background:var(--cream);position:sticky;top:0;z-index:60}
.header-top{
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;
  gap:24px;padding:22px 0 10px;
}
.brand img{max-height:34px;width:auto}
.header-mark img{max-height:52px;width:auto}

.header-bar{
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;
  gap:24px;padding:6px 0 14px;flex-wrap:wrap;
}
.nav{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0;list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.nav li{margin:0;position:relative}
.nav li + li::before{
  content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);
  width:1px;height:16px;background:var(--gold);opacity:.65;
}
.nav a{
  display:block;padding:10px 22px;font-size:17px;color:#000;
  transition:color .18s ease;
}
.nav a:hover,.nav a:focus-visible{color:var(--gold)}
.nav a[aria-current="page"]{color:var(--gold)}

.header-actions{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.btn{
  display:inline-block;padding:13px 26px;font-size:14px;line-height:1;
  border:2px solid transparent;border-radius:0;cursor:pointer;
  transition:background-color .22s ease,color .22s ease,border-color .22s ease;
}
.btn--gold{background:var(--gold);color:#fff;border-color:transparent}
.btn--gold:hover{background:var(--primary);color:#fff}
.btn--green{background:var(--primary);color:#fff;border-color:#333}
.btn--green:hover{background:var(--gold);border-color:var(--gold)}
.btn--hero{
  background:var(--gold);color:var(--primary);font-size:17px;padding:14px 28px;
  box-shadow:-8px 6px 15px rgba(0,0,0,.3);
}
.btn--hero:hover{background:var(--paper);color:var(--primary)}

.burger{
  display:none;width:44px;height:44px;background:none;border:0;padding:10px;
  cursor:pointer;
}
.burger span{display:block;height:2px;background:#3e3e3e;margin:5px 0;transition:.25s}
.burger[aria-expanded="true"] span:nth-child(1){transform:translateY(7px) rotate(45deg)}
.burger[aria-expanded="true"] span:nth-child(2){opacity:0}
.burger[aria-expanded="true"] span:nth-child(3){transform:translateY(-7px) rotate(-45deg)}

/* ============================================================
   TICKER
   ============================================================ */
.ticker-strip{background:var(--cream);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(41,41,28,.08)}

/* ============================================================
   HERO
   ============================================================ */
.hero{
  position:relative;isolation:isolate;color:#fff;
  background:url('https://content.app-sources.com/s/512260917219066661/uploads/Images/Home_page_banner-9177436.jpg?format=webp') center/cover no-repeat fixed;
  padding:96px 0 100px;
}
.hero::before{
  content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-1;
  background:rgba(12,27,13,.835);
}
.hero-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:55% 45%;gap:40px;align-items:center}
.hero h1{
  font-size:clamp(48px,7.2vw,90px);line-height:1;color:var(--paper);
  margin:0 0 4px;letter-spacing:-.022em;
}
.hero h1 .it{color:var(--gold);display:block}
.hero p{color:rgba(255,255,255,.77);max-width:44ch;margin:22px 0 0}
.hero-widget{min-height:340px}
.hero-widget .tradingview-widget-container{height:100%}

/* ============================================================
   SPLIT (image + copy)
   ============================================================ */
.split{display:grid;gap:0;align-items:stretch}
.split--text-first{grid-template-columns:47% 53%}
.split--image-first{grid-template-columns:49% 51%}
.split .copy{padding:56px 5vw 56px 0}
.split--image-first .copy{padding:56px 0 56px 5vw}
.split figure{margin:0}
.split figure img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.split blockquote{
  margin:0 0 20px;padding-left:18px;border-left:3px solid var(--gold);
  font-style:italic;color:var(--ink);
}

.principles{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:18px 0 0}
.principles li{
  padding:9px 0 9px 0;line-height:1.35;color:var(--primary);
  border-bottom:1px solid rgba(41,41,28,.12);
}
.principles li:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.principles b{font-weight:700}

/* ============================================================
   CARD GRIDS
   ============================================================ */
.grid{display:grid;gap:0}
.grid-3{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}
.grid-2{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}

.cell{border:1px solid var(--hairline);padding:28px 26px;margin:-0.5px}
.dark .cell{border-color:var(--hairline-gold)}
.cell .rule{
  display:block;width:34px;height:2px;background:var(--gold);margin:0 0 18px;
}
.cell h3{
  font-size:18px;font-style:italic;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink);
  margin:0 0 10px;line-height:1.25;
}
.dark .cell h3{color:var(--paper);font-style:normal}
.cell p{margin:0;line-height:1.35}
.cell figure{margin:0 0 16px}
.cell figure img{width:100%;max-width:230px;height:auto}

/* Entity spec rows */
.entity-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px;margin-bottom:6px}
.entity-head img{max-height:74px;width:auto}
.entity-head h3{font-size:22px;color:#fff;font-style:normal;margin:0}
.entity-sub{color:#ccc;margin:0 0 22px}
.spec{
  display:flex;align-items:baseline;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;
  padding:12px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(204,204,204,.2);
}
.spec:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.spec dt{color:var(--muted-dark);font-family:var(--display);font-size:20px}
.spec dd{margin:0;color:var(--gold);font-family:var(--display);font-size:20px;text-align:right}
.spec dd.sm{font-size:17px}

/* Services rows */
.srow{display:grid;grid-template-columns:30% 70%;gap:0}
.srow .srow-title{border:1px solid var(--hairline);padding:34px 28px;margin:-0.5px}
.srow .srow-body{border:1px solid var(--hairline);padding:30px 28px;margin:-0.5px}
.srow h3{font-size:clamp(22px,2.2vw,28px);color:var(--primary);margin:0 0 10px;font-style:normal}
.srow .srow-title p{margin:0;color:var(--muted)}

/* BUGFIX: the .srow rules above are declared after .dark .cell and match
   at equal-or-greater specificity, so inside a dark section they were
   winning with light-theme colours — dark grey text and dark borders on
   the dark green ground, i.e. invisible. Re-stated in dark scope. */
.dark .srow-title,.dark .srow-body{border-color:var(--hairline-gold)}
.dark .srow .srow-title p{color:var(--paper)}
.dark .srow .srow-title h3,.dark .srow .srow-body h3{color:var(--paper)}
.dark .srow .srow-body li,.dark .srow .srow-body p{color:var(--paper)}

.disclosure{
  padding:26px 0 0;font-family:var(--display);font-size:17px;color:var(--ink);
  line-height:1.5;
}
.disclosure b{font-style:italic}

/* "Wise to Rise Money" — was an inline grid, which media queries cannot
   override, so it stayed 70/30 on phones and crushed the image. */
.wise{display:grid;grid-template-columns:70% 30%;gap:32px;align-items:center}
.wise-title{color:var(--primary);font-size:clamp(26px,3.4vw,36px)}
.wise-rule{display:block;width:60px;height:2px;background:var(--gold);margin:16px 0 20px}
.wise figure{margin:0}

/* ============================================================
   LEADERSHIP
   ============================================================ */
.person{
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:19% 81%;gap:0;align-items:stretch;
  padding:18px 0;
}
.person__photo img{width:100%;height:100%;max-height:520px;object-fit:cover;object-position:top center}
.person__body{padding:6px 0 6px 34px;border-left:1px solid var(--hairline-gold)}
.person__name{font-size:clamp(24px,2.4vw,28px);color:var(--paper);margin:0 0 4px}
.person__role{color:var(--gold);margin:0 0 2px}
.person__firm{color:var(--paper);font-size:15px;margin:0 0 14px;opacity:.92}
.person__meta{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px 28px;margin:0 0 16px}
.person__meta span{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;
  color:rgba(204,204,204,.72);font-size:15px;
}
.person__bio{border-top:1px solid var(--hairline-gold);padding-top:18px;margin:0 0 20px}
.person__bio p{margin:0;color:#fff}
.hl-title{color:var(--gold);font-size:18px;font-style:italic;margin:0 0 12px}
.hl{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:0;display:grid;gap:10px}
.hl li{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start;color:var(--paper);margin:0}

.dot{
  flex:0 0 auto;width:22px;height:22px;border:1px solid var(--gold);
  border-radius:50%;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  color:var(--gold);font-size:12px;line-height:1;margin-top:2px;
}

/* ============================================================
   TABLE
   ============================================================ */
.table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;margin-top:8px}
.table th,.table td{
  border:1px solid rgba(68,68,68,.21);padding:14px 18px;text-align:left;
  font-size:16px;vertical-align:top;
}
.table th{font-weight:700;color:var(--primary);background:transparent}
.table th:first-child{color:#000}
.table td:first-child{width:32%}

/* ============================================================
   FOOTER
   ============================================================ */
.footer-top{border-top:1px solid rgba(200,168,75,.34);padding-top:44px}
/* BUGFIX: 32+20+22+26 = 100%, plus three 24px gaps, overflowed the page by
   8px. fr units divide what is left AFTER the gaps, so they cannot overflow;
   min-width:0 stops a long line in the contact column forcing its track wider. */
.footer-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.6fr 1fr 1.1fr 1.3fr;gap:24px}
.footer-grid > *{min-width:0}
.footer-contact{overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.footer-brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;margin-bottom:14px}
.footer-brand img{max-height:58px;width:auto}
.footer-brand h4{font-size:16px;color:#000;margin:0;font-weight:400;line-height:1.3}
.footer h4.col-title{color:var(--gold);font-size:20px;margin:0 0 18px}
/* BUGFIX: was style="visibility:hidden", which still occupied ~40px once
   the footer columns stacked on mobile, leaving a phantom gap. */
.col-title--spacer{visibility:hidden}
.footer-links{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:0;line-height:2}
.footer-links li{margin:0}
.footer-links a{color:#000}
.footer-links a:hover{color:var(--gold)}
.footer-contact p{color:#000;margin:0 0 4px}
.footer-contact .row{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start;margin-bottom:16px}
.footer-contact .ico{color:var(--gold);font-size:20px;line-height:1.3}
.copyright{text-align:center;padding:30px 0 22px;font-size:14px;color:#000}
.rebel-bar{
  background:#000;color:#fff;text-align:center;font-size:14px;font-weight:700;
  padding:12px 16px;
}
.rebel-bar a{font-weight:400;text-decoration:underline}

/* ============================================================
   RESPONSIVE
   ============================================================ */
@media (max-width:1024px){
  .wise{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .wise figure{max-width:420px}
  .hero-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .split--text-first,.split--image-first{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .split .copy,.split--image-first .copy{padding:44px 0}
  .split figure{order:-1}
  .grid-3{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
  .footer-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
}
@media (max-width:860px){
  :root{--gutter:22px}
  .burger{display:block}
  .nav{
    display:none;position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:100%;
    flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch;background:var(--cream);
    border-top:1px solid rgba(41,41,28,.12);
    box-shadow:0 18px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.12);padding:8px 0;
  }
  .nav.is-open{display:flex}
  .nav li + li::before{display:none}
  .nav a{padding:14px 22px;text-align:center}
  .header-bar{position:relative;justify-content:space-between}
  .header-actions{gap:10px}
  .btn{padding:11px 18px;font-size:13px}
  .hero{background-attachment:scroll;padding:64px 0}
  .grid-3,.grid-2{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .srow{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .person{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:20px}
  .person__body{padding:0;border-left:0}
  .person__photo img{max-height:420px}
  .footer-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .col-title--spacer{display:none}
  .table td:first-child{width:38%}
  .table th,.table td{padding:11px 12px;font-size:15px}
}
/* BUGFIX: background-attachment:fixed was only reverted at <=860px, but
   iOS/iPadOS renders it wrong (zoomed / jumping) at every width. Key off
   the input type instead of the viewport. */
@media (hover:none),(pointer:coarse){
  .hero{background-attachment:scroll}
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  html{scroll-behavior:auto}
  *{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}
  .hero{background-attachment:scroll}
}
</style>
</head>

<script>
(function(){
  /* Keep --header-h in step with the sticky header so every in-page anchor
     (and any kkj-home.html#section arrived at from another page) lands
     below it rather than underneath it. */
  var header = document.querySelector('.site-header');
  function syncHeaderHeight(){
    if(!header) return;
    var h = Math.ceil(header.getBoundingClientRect().height);
    document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--header-h', h + 'px');
  }
  syncHeaderHeight();
  window.addEventListener('resize', syncHeaderHeight);
  window.addEventListener('load', function(){
    syncHeaderHeight();
    /* A hash present on first load is resolved before the fonts settle and
       before --header-h is known, so re-apply it once things are stable. */
    if(location.hash){
      var target = document.querySelector(location.hash);
      if(target) target.scrollIntoView();
    }
  });

  var burger = document.getElementById('burger');
  var nav = document.getElementById('primary-nav');
  if(!burger || !nav) return;

  burger.addEventListener('click', function(){
    var open = nav.classList.toggle('is-open');
    burger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', open ? 'true' : 'false');
  });

  nav.addEventListener('click', function(e){
    if(e.target.tagName === 'A'){
      nav.classList.remove('is-open');
      burger.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');
    }
  });

  document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){
    if(e.key === 'Escape'){
      nav.classList.remove('is-open');
      burger.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');
    }
  });
})();
</script>

<script>
    document.addEventListener("scroll", function() {
        let pageFooter = document.querySelector(".page-footer");
        let footer = document.querySelector(".footer");
        let scrollPosition = window.scrollY + window.innerHeight;
        let footerHeight = pageFooter.offsetHeight;
        let footerTriggerPosition = pageFooter.offsetTop + (footerHeight/2);
        
        if (scrollPosition >= footerTriggerPosition) {
            footer.style.display = "block";
        } else {
            footer.style.display = "none";
        }
    });

    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
        let pageFooter = document.querySelector(".page-footer");

            footer.className = "footer";
